acceptance_criteria: **Desktop board.** At 1440 x 900 the page shows, in this order:
**Phone board.** At 390 x 844 with cookie `psl_mock_month_end=board-phone`, the page shows:

**Design fidelity.** The design-fidelity check passes on `SCR-36-desktop.dc.html` at 1440 (default data) and `SCR-36-mobile.dc.html` at 390 (`board-phone`): 100% of board elements after the approved exceptions, and visual ≥ 90. The approved exceptions in `delivery/features/F-10/fidelity-exceptions.json` are only:

**Links go to work items.** Each of the six other rows' "Open" has `href="/work/W-1601"` … `"/work/W-1606"` in order. "Import the missing statement" has `href="/work/W-1601"` on both breakpoints. No href on the page contains `SCR-`, `.dc.html` or `claude.ai`.

**Counts are taken as returned.** A unit test serves a body whose `summary` is `{done: 5, waiting: 0, in_progress: 9, total: 4}` (deliberately inconsistent with `tasks`) and asserts the strip shows "5 of 4", "0" and "9". A body with no `summary` shows "Unknown" in all three cells and "Unknown done · Unknown waiting" on the phone.

**Wrong user.** With cookie `psl_mock_persona=pm` (and separately `none`), the page shows "You can’t open this month-end checklist" and "Back to my queue", and no "₦", no task title and no count appears. Scenario 403 and scenario 404 render identical DOM in `main`.

**Signed out.** With `psl_mock_scenario=401`, the frame's signed-out state is shown (the frame's `/me` 401 path). With `/me` succeeding and month-end answering 401 (unit test with a mocked client), the page shows `SignedOutState` and the sign-in link's `next` is `/finance/month-end?period=2026-10`.

**Load failure.** If the month-end read returns 500 or the network fails (unit test), the error card shows "We couldn’t load the month-end checklist. Your work is safe; nothing was changed." with "Reference <code> for support." Try again re-reads, and on success the board shows. An answer that arrives after a retry has started is ignored.
**Empty.** `psl_mock_month_end=empty` shows the strip ("0 of 0", "0", "0", "Unknown" cash) and "No month-end tasks you can see for October 2026.", with no table, cards, note or action.

**Back link.** On the phone, "← Finance" opened from `/my-work` (navigate there, then to the page) returns to `/my-work` via history. Opened directly in a fresh tab, its href `/my-work` is followed. It is hidden at 1440.

**No sample tag, no debug identifiers.** No "SAMPLE DATA" text appears at either breakpoint (the build has no `NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOW_SAMPLE_LABEL`). No work id (`W-16xx`), state key (`action_needed`) or process ID is visible as text on the page.

risk.rationale: I rated it high: - The page shows a cash total. A-MONTHEND and INV-UNKNOWN (handoff.md:789-807) make a 0 or blank in place of Unknown a money error. - The current contract cannot carry "known plus Unknown" (endpoints.csv:19), so the money shape is a frontend proposal (`contract-change`). - It also lists restricted payroll work. INV-RESTRICTED (handoff.md:871-889) and JR-06 require that the row never links or exposes payroll detail, so `security` reviews that the frontend renders only what is returned. Surfaces: - `ui`: SCR-36 on desktop and phone. - `api`: the first read of E-MONTH-END. - `payments`: cash received. - `security`: the restricted row. - `contract-change`: the consumer side of the PMO-0-1 proposal. There is no `auth` (no sign-in or role logic) and no `data-migration`. There is no `product-decision`, because the interpretations in PMO-0-3 to PMO-0-5 go to product acceptance rather than deciding a business rule.

findings.summary: AC12 asks for a test that "an answer that arrives after a retry has started is ignored". The unit test at `frontend/tests/finance-month-end.test.tsx` ("an answer to a superseded read is ignored") covers only a superseded period. The same request counter guards retries (`useMonthEnd.ts:17-25`), and the UI offers no Try again while a read is pending, so the risk is low. A retry-specific case (first read pending, `retry()` called, first answer resolves late) would cover the criterion literally.

Out-of-contract values crash the page instead of degrading. `taskTag` reads `STATE_TAGS[task.state].text` (model.ts:111-114), `AgentNote` reads `AGENT_NAMES[note.agent].name` (MonthEndView.tsx:143) and `formatClock` throws a RangeError on an invalid `as_of`. A tone outside the enum yields `psl-tag--undefined`. Both v4 and v7 close these enums and v7 types `as_of` as date-time, so a conforming backend never triggers this. When T-FINANCE lands, a defensive fallback (neutral tag, no note, no as-of) would be cheap.

The full cash value is exposed only through `aria-describedby` on a plain `<span>` (MonthEndView.tsx:63-68). The spec mandates this, so it is not a build defect. However, screen readers often don't announce descriptions on non-focusable static text, so the "full value for screen readers" goal may not be reached in practice. I am flagging it for the UX/accessibility review to confirm with a screen reader. An alternative is a visually hidden text sibling.

Six identical "Open" links in the desktop table have no row-specific accessible name, so a screen-reader link list is ambiguous. The board draws "Open", so keep the visible text and add a visually hidden suffix or aria-label such as "Open Bank statements". frontend/src/features/finance/month-end/MonthEndView.tsx

findings.summary: On a phone with no tasks (`psl_mock_month_end=empty`, 390 x 844), the "No month-end tasks you can see for October 2026." panel is a 690px-tall white box running from under the summary line to the bottom of the screen. Expected: a panel sized to its text, as on desktop and on the other empty states in the app. Cause: on phones `.monthend-row` is `display: contents`, so `.monthend-empty` becomes a direct child of the `.monthend` column, which has a full-screen `min-height`. The empty panel's desktop sizing `flex: 999 1 600px` then makes it grow to fill that height (computed height 690.25px, flex `999 1 600px`). Fix: inside the phone media query give `.monthend-empty` `flex: none` (or restrict the 999 rule to the desktop row). `frontend/src/features/finance/month-end/month-end.css:23`; see round-1/fidelity-review/states/empty-390.png.

findings.summary: Enum values from the response are used as lookup keys without a guard. If a backend sends an `agent_note.agent` outside tola/chidi/zainab, `AGENT_NAMES[note.agent]` is undefined and `agent.name` throws, so the whole page falls to the error boundary. That is also where the agent string is put into the `/agents/{agent}.png` src. In the same way, an unknown `state` makes `STATE_TAGS[task.state].text` throw, and an unknown `tone` gives the class `psl-tag--undefined`. All of these fail closed: no data is exposed, and the image path stays same-origin. Expected: skip the note, or fall back to a neutral tag, when a value is not in the known set. Paths: frontend/src/features/finance/month-end/MonthEndView.tsx:153-156, frontend/src/features/finance/month-end/model.ts:110-114.

`feature.json` has `operation_ids: []`, although E-MONTH-END is in scope (spec Summary, readiness "Endpoints"). The record cannot show operation coverage for this feature. D-19 records it as interim until the frame's back-link slot (D-23). The design engineer should confirm this when giving product acceptance.
